'''Lord of the Mind's Eye''' was the self-proclaimed title that was held by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Glovoc]] during the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]] and his subsequent time in [[Suspended animation/Legends|stasis]].<ref name="GoI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The title was first mentioned in the [[2010]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[:Category:Wizards of the Coast sourcebooks|sourcebook]] ''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''. It is likely a reference to ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'', the first released [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] [[Book|novel]].
